# Article 4 Institute — European AI Sovereignty Observatory
> Independent research and open tracking engine for European public-sector AI adoptions, cloud infrastructure dependencies, and EU AI Act readiness.

## Core Purpose
The Observatory tracks and indexes artificial intelligence adoptions across public sector entities in Europe, measuring compliance with the EU AI Act and evaluating sovereign infrastructure vs foreign cloud dependencies.

## Primary Metrics Monitored
- Public Sector AI Tooling Index (France, Germany, Spain, EU Institutions)
- Infrastructure Sovereignty Classification (SecNumCloud, Sovereign GovCloud vs US Hyperscalers)
- EU AI Act Transparency & Regulatory Compliance Status

## Research Methodology & Technology
- Methodology: Data extracted from official procurement releases, government digital directorates (e.g., DINUM), and public audits.
- Assessment Engine: Automated compliance benchmarking and security assurance powered by the open framework at SafeAI.report.

## Governance & Leadership
- Organization: L'Institut Article 4 (A4I) (Operating as a neutral French non-profit initiative under Association 1901).
- Lead Researcher: Adel El Bouzagaoui, Research Director & AI Governance Lead.
